''See also: [[Gadrael Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Gadrael, also known as the [[Titan]], is the Second [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan Court]] and serves as the loyal right hand to [[Makiel]]. A compact, muscular man with dark blue or grayish skin and rows of horns instead of hair, he possesses an [[aura]] of invincibility that makes him appear more like a [[sacred beast]] than a human. He wears the seamless white liquid armor characteristic of the [[Abidan]] and carries the Mantle of Gadrael, which appears as a cape of intense starfire. His primary defensive tool is the [[Shield of Gadrael]], a black circular buckler on his forearm that can expand into a massive bulwark of gleaming [[steel]] with molten-like veins. As a [[Judge]], Gadrael is characterized by an unwavering, granite-like firmness and a temperament of cold fury. He is deeply committed to the cause of the [[Abidan]], often acting with extreme [[Authority|authority]] and even threatening execution for those who fail their duties. Despite his loyalty to [[Makiel]], he is capable of independent action and has been known to intervene personally in various affairs. He is considered one of the most difficult beings in existence to destroy, serving as a primary defender and a symbol of absolute protection.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Gadrael is a compact, muscular [[Titan]] with dusky blue or grayish skin and blue eyes that hold a spark of [[Way|the Way]]. Instead of hair, he has tight-packed horns or short spikes on his scalp and wears liquid-smooth white armor. He also wears a [[Judge]]'s Mantle made of pure starfire and carries a black buckler.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A [[stone]]-faced individual who does not smile, Gadrael serves as the loyal right hand to [[Makiel]] and a [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan Court]]. He acts with [[Authority|authority]], possessing the power to punish [[Abidan]] for rule-breaking or perform immediate executions. He has also expressed interest in relinquishing his seat on the [[Court]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Gadrael serves as the loyal right hand to [[Makiel]]. He has interacted with [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] by warning her of an upcoming trial, and he previously sealed the mouth of Ozriel. Additionally, Gadrael binds, burdens, and warns [[Lindon]] regarding his mission and the consequences of betrayal.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Gadrael utilizes the [[Shield of the Titan]], a gleaming [[steel]] bulwark featuring red-hot veins. He possesses the power to bind, burden, and warn others, such as when he binds individuals to specific missions or warns them of the consequences of betrayal. Additionally, previous generations used [[Script|script-formations]] to seal locations like [[Asylum]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Threshold: Stories from Cradle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Gadrael is an [[Abidan]] with grayish skin, short spikes on his scalp, and blue eyes that contain a spark of [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref> Though [[Lindon]] expected him to act personally, Gadrael is actually a [[Judge]] who possesses the [[Authority|authority]] to perform immediate executions and may punish other [[Abidan]] for rule-breaking.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> Utilizing his ability to bind, burden, and warn others, he binds [[Lindon]] to a specific mission that prevents him from contacting his Division, seeking more power, or undermining world stability.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> He further burdens [[Lindon]] with the weight of their cause and warns his associates that any betrayal will lead to censure or execution.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /> After judging [[Lindon]]'s actions and finding him innocent, Gadrael discussed the possibility of giving up his seat on the [[Court]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] has grayish skin and short spikes on his scalp.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] can bind, burden, and warn others.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] binds [[Lindon]] to his mission, preventing him from seeking power beyond what he has, undermining world stability, or contacting his Division.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] burdens [[Lindon]] with the weight of their cause.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] warns [[Lindon]] and his associates that betrayal will result in execution or censure.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Gadrael]] has blue eyes containing a spark of [[Way|the Way]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“You will stand trial for this,” Gadrael warned Suriel.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|“All will be answered for,” that man said with icy calm. “You have cost us enough time already. Gadrael.”<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c27" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|“I bind you, I burden you, and I warn you.”<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|“I bind you to your mission. You may not seek power beyond what you have, you may not seek to undermine the stability of the world you inhabit, and you may not contact your Division.”<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|“I burden you with the weight of our cause,” Gadrael continued.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7" />}}
